subcommands.build: Bundle TypeScript and JavaScript into a single file
subcommands.create: Create a new project from a template
subcommands.init: Initialize a Bun project in the current directory
subcommands.link: Register or link a local npm package
subcommands.outdated: Display the latest versions of outdated dependencies
subcommands.pm: Manage packages and the package cache
subcommands.run: Execute a file or a package.json script
subcommands.test: Run unit tests with Bun's test runner
subcommands.upgrade: Upgrade to the latest version of Bun
subcommands.x: Auto-install and execute a package binary
